I replied to Dana in the thread in #north-random. I confirmed the update (the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines is due 26 August) and said I'm not taking any action for now, as she asked.

I also asked her to confirm the year. It's 14 October 2026, so 26 August this year has already passed, and she probably means 26 August 2027.
